description: Text an existing report's link to a phone (POST /reports/:token/text) through the guarded SMS lane: the number must belong to a worker or roster entry of your org, burst limits, the SMS quota and STOP opt-outs apply, and the report's task list proves ownership. token is the report token (tascan_mint_completion_report / tascan_generate_report). Full tier (it sends to a person).

note.description: Optional short intro, at most 160 characters
